chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"Thursday is a day loved by Allah, His Messenger, and His angels."

key_terms.اللَّهُ: Allah; the Divine Being who loves this day
key_terms.الْخَمِيسِ: Thursday; the particular day mentioned as beloved
key_terms.رَسُولُهُ: His Messenger; the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم who also loves this day
key_terms.مَلَائِكَتُهُ: His angels; the angels who share regard for this day
key_terms.يَوْمُ: day; a specified time being described with merit
key_terms.يُحِبُّهُ: loves it; denotes special favor and esteem

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about the virtue of Thursday?
ai.summary: This hadith states that Thursday is a day beloved to Allah, His Messenger صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, and His angels. It indicates the virtue of this day and supports its positive religious significance in matters such as recommended timing and conduct.
